title: Reefer Cargo Services: Temperature Tolerance, Logging Interval and Credit Threshold
content:
Reefer Cargo Services judges a unit's temperature performance with three tier figures: the tolerance band either side of the set point, the interval at which the unit's temperature recorder logs readings, and the length of continuous time outside the band from which the service qualifies for an excursion credit.

| Tier | Tolerance either side of the set point (°C) | Recorder logging interval (minutes) | Continuous minutes outside tolerance that qualify for a credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | 2.0 | 60 | 0 (no credit on this tier) |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 1.5 | 15 | 240 |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 0.5 | 15 | 120 |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 1.0 | 15 | 180 |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 1.0 | 5 | 60 |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | 3.0 | 15 | 240 |

## What each figure measures

- **Tolerance.** The return-air temperature is compared with the set point; the band reaches this many degrees above and below it.
- **Logging interval.** The temperature recorder of the unit writes a reading at this spacing, in whole minutes.
- **Qualifying length.** The number of continuous minutes outside the band at which a credit becomes available; a figure of 0 marks a tier that earns no excursion credit at all.

## Hypothetical band check

On a unit carried at a set point of 4.0 °C under a tier with the Monitored tolerance, the band runs from 2.5 °C to 5.5 °C; a return-air reading of 5.8 °C lies outside it and a reading of 5.2 °C inside it. The same 5.8 °C reading would sit inside the band on a tier with the Standard tolerance, whose band would run from 2.0 °C to 6.0 °C.
